items.text: "i started smoking at the age of 8 after working off feeble and other negative traits others like me born on this kleg are blessed with. my father a pirate my mother a shipbreaker i turned to hacking at 14, then quickly software engineering. working for the nsa, cia and any other 3 letter organization i learned what i needed and got out, at 20 i started wandering after getting my EVA cert. i was burned badly in a fire with some cargo once, fought a man over a scam on another and made a friend from helping form a gig, met a cop, got some street cred learned to gamble and set off with a Ryokka Tu Shuttle, just a little dingy but its a enough. ive never felt debt like this but its amazing how fast if forgot about it. only worried about my ship i fixed it ever 2 shifts, but quickly i found not having a license led to the law coming in. the first cop i killed well i didn't want to do it, truly i thought of him as a friend. .. .i liked him, imagine what id do to somebody i didnt like. the thought sent shivers down my back. i looted the maura intakes and a few other goodies and got out of there only after jetting any evidence. this happened a few times, in different ways over a few days with some pirates, cops some i liked some i didn't. now i have 400k a massive debt still but a ship built of the finest martials and can go so fast it will kill you from take off to max speed. i met a girl i fell for, she died and then me and the black market dealer fell for each other not sure how thats ganna blow up. slowing making friends as a person that has no humor and likes to tell jokes is well funny. also enjoying pain and being slow to heal is a joy. all together my short vision and bad hearing are the least of my worrys, ive quickly learned all the skills ive needed to build a space station if needed so i look forward to making friends and expanding. im hoping to have my own smaller ship well having them run the second larger one." its only been a few days in game 69 hours irl sense i started playing 10 days ago. it feels like neo scavenger with a top down Project zomboid like world but set in space and taking care of the ship is more the hassel then your person. my only compliant is audio. the music is great but theres long periods with none, which would be fine if we had louder or more living world souds or ambiet noise. also the ui clicks and checkmarks are about 2x louder then the game sound then put on a space helmet and do x16 work on a large item with checkmark sounds every second and it will make you wanna mute the game. i hope that detail only helps the dev. there are audio sliders and you will be sliding them often for diffrent vibes or leaving some lower and turning on background music of your own.
items.text_zh: “我在8岁时开始抽烟，因为要摆脱虚弱和其他负面特质，而像我这样出生在这个kleg上的人却天生就有这些。我的父亲是个海盗，母亲是个拆船工，我在14岁时转向黑客，然后很快做起了软件工程。为NSA、CIA和其他任何三个字母的机构工作，我学到了我需要的东西然后脱身，20岁时拿到EVA证书后开始四处游荡。我曾经因为一些货物在一场火灾中被严重烧伤，还因为另一场骗局和别人打过架，因为帮忙组建一个活儿而交了个朋友，遇到过一个警察，攒了点街头声望，学会了赌博，然后带着一艘Ryokka Tu穿梭机出发了，只是个小破船但够用了。我从未感受过这样的债务，但令人惊讶的是我多快就忘了它。我只担心我的船，每两个班次就修一次，但很快我发现没有执照会导致法律找上门来。我杀的第一个警察，好吧，我并不想那么做，我真的把他当朋友。……我喜欢他，想象一下我会对我不喜欢的人做什么。这个念头让我脊背发凉。我搜刮了maura进气口和其他一些好东西，在喷掉所有证据后才离开那里。这种事发生过几次，在几天里以不同的方式，和一些海盗、警察，有些我喜欢有些我不喜欢。现在我有40万，仍然是一大笔债务，但有一艘用最好的材料打造的船，速度快到从起飞到最高速能要了你的命。我遇到一个我爱上的女孩，她死了，然后我和黑市商人互相爱上了，不知道那会怎么炸开。作为一个没有幽默感又喜欢讲笑话的人，慢慢交朋友，嗯，挺搞笑的。还有享受疼痛和愈合缓慢也是一种乐趣。总之，我的近视和听力不好是我最不担心的事，我很快就学会了如果需要建造空间站所需的所有技能，所以我期待交朋友和扩张。我希望拥有自己的一艘较小的船，同时让他们经营第二艘更大的船。”游戏里才过了几天，现实中69小时，因为我10天前开始玩。感觉就像《Neo Scavenger》加上俯视角《Project Zomboid》那样的世界，但设定在太空，而且照顾飞船比照顾你自己更麻烦。我唯一的抱怨是音频。音乐很棒，但有很长一段时间没有音乐，如果我们有更响亮或更有生气的世界音效或环境噪音，那倒也没问题。还有UI的点击声和勾选声大约比游戏声音响2倍，然后戴上太空头盔，在一个大物品上做x16的工作，每秒都有勾选声，这会让你想静音游戏。我希望这个细节能帮到开发者。有音频滑块，你会经常滑动它们来适应不同的氛围，或者把一些调低然后打开你自己的背景音乐。

observations.description: UI点击和勾选音效比游戏音效响约两倍
